Text: <cough> ...Ugh... <wheeze> My next charge shall be my last... Player, gift your aether unto the Elder Seedser!
<cough> ...Ugh... <wheeze> My next charge shall be my last... Player, gift your aether unto the Elder Seedseer!
Our brotherbond is unbreakable!
Now! We war together!
Hrhhh... Hrhhh... HRAAAGGGHHH!!!
We'll windknock you from the ground up!
My sword is as sharp as my tongueflaps!
Leave Chewchum Popoto alone, you cheatsneak!
Chewchum Popoto! Are you all right!?
*Now* you're asking for it!
Dodgedance my blastbombs!
I-I'm not nervous! *You're* nervous!
Lend me your strength, Chewchum Popoto!
Obey me, daughter of man!
Thy blades to do my bidding.
All of creation─mine to wield!
No escape. *Beastmaster*.
By steel, thy flesh be seared!
Ghhhrrrhhh! Die... DIE!
My forest... My kindred... All shall be avenged!
Prove your strength with answers true.
What knowledge have you of numbers?
How mighty is your memory?
Riddle me this─which child is kin of cloud?
Riddle me this─which child is kin of scale?
Riddle me this─which child is kin of beast?
Riddle me this─which child is kin of wave?
Forsooth. Aread me right and fortune yields its blessings.
Amiss. Aread me false and punishment awaits.
Your strength has been proven.
Time to brawl, kupo! Bring it on!
You won't stand a chance against our magicks! Poms away!
Pull yourselves together! Pompile them if you have to, just *win*, kupo!
May our bonded souls prove true. Have at thee!
You shall not escape my blades!
Never have I felt so free... Free to reign supreme!
Mine is a terrible power... Forget not our former shackles.
Guttler, fire for our steel!
Partake of my might, Lauda. Fell our foes!
Our spirits flicker... Nay, let them kindle anew!
The path Guttler and I have chosen... It shall not end here!
Can you detect the invisible?
Five seconds remain.
Four...
Three...
Two...
One...
I cannot deny your strength...but neither shall I forfeit!
Riddle me this─where do evens lie?
Riddle me this─wherein lie the odds?
Riddle me this─what can threes divide?
Riddle me this─which numbers are in prime?
Make your choice. Care not to err.
What are these creatures...?
They are *clearly* not wild animals!
Questions can wait till after the battle!
Ready for another round?
Of course. Leave the healing to me.
Enough. Have at you!
They're up to something. Be ready!
I shall fortify our defenses!
What are they playing at?
Let him go!
Thank you.
'Tis curious, though... They made no attempt to strike us while we were bound.
Could it be...their true objective is our capture?
What now...
It appears the onslaught has halted...
I'll watch your backs from here! Do as I say and you'll be fine!
She does seem to know what she's doing...
There's a surge in water energies! Keep your distance!
It's harnessing water!
Get clear before it bursts!
Look out! Those water orbs are going to fall!
Be careful how they bounce!
This concentration of magic... Quickly, get back!
You do not want to be caught in that!
They're trying to bind us again!
Oh no you don't!
Thank you for the timely aid!
Deal with the big one! I'll handle the rest!
It's...siphoning the isle's aether!?
It's gathering power! Throw everything you have at its heart!
Hmph. This calls for a heavier hand.
Unleash your rage, Nidhogg!
Yes, it's reeling! Now's your chance!
Down with you!
Defeat the hostile creatures!
More of them...
Let the feast begin!
Come, my fair sisters! Entertain our guests.
Feed me... Let me drink deep of your essence...
Yield to your yearning...
Love is the sweetest poison, is it not?
